summary.text: Alex Burton is a Democratic state representative from Indiana House District 77, which he has represented since November 2024, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists him as the only candidate in the general election for the seat.

paragraphs.text: Alex Burton was born in Evansville, Indiana.
He earned a bachelor's degree from Indiana State University in 2011 and a graduate degree from Western Kentucky University in 2013, and his career experience includes business management.
In a Ballotpedia survey, his campaign described him as a member of the Evansville City Council for the 4th Ward since 2019 who served as council president.
Burton won the seat in 2024, succeeding Ryan Hatfield, running unopposed in the general election.
For 2025-2026, Ballotpedia lists him on the Family, Children and Human Affairs, House Judiciary, House Natural Resources, and Utilities, Energy and Telecommunications committees.
